subject.title: fix(cron): preserve startup catch-up jobs across restarts

question: Does the cron owner approve persisting the exact startup catch-up slot in CronJobState as the canonical cross-restart scheduling marker?
rationale: The patch changes durable state used to decide whether maintenance may repair a future cron time; that lifecycle choice is safe to review mechanically but should be explicitly accepted by the responsible owner.

options.title: Approve the persisted marker
options.body: Accept the optional internal state field and its tested clearing rules as the canonical way to preserve startup catch-up slots across restarts.

options.title: Request an explicit upgrade fixture
options.body: Ask for one additional test loading a pre-marker persisted job record to make the old-state upgrade behavior visible before approval.

recommendation.title: Approve the persisted marker
recommendation.body: Accept the optional internal state field and its tested clearing rules as the canonical way to preserve startup catch-up slots across restarts.
